whatThisIs: [The Children Item exchange is located in Mid Cambridge, a place to trade and receive new clothes and items for growing children. Upon signing up you will receive 10 credits that can be used on children's clothing or eligible items. You may also volunteer to earn more credits. Solutions at work stock items aiming for children one to sixteen.]

whoItHelps: Families looking to trade out clothing that has been out grown
Individual’s looking for a free alternative to provide age appropriate gear
whatToKnow: Located at 1151 Massachusetts Ave, Cambridge, MA 02138.

Their application process will request: Contact information for the Intake form, Your child’s birth certificate or health insurance card to prove that the child is yours OR If pregnant, a letter from your doctor stating that you are pregnant, and some basic demographic information such as your gender and the age of your child
